prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a square premium fantasy tabletop RPG cover BACKDROP for JDR Runeterra, centered on Freljord. The supplied reference image is ONLY a color and brand mood reference: its antique gold contrasts with blue-black and icy blue. Do not draw any logo, letters or text; the exact supplied logo will be composited later. A magnificent rugged snow-covered Freljord mountain pass, ancient dark stone shapes and faint ice blue glow, painterly League of Legends inspired environmental concept art, cinematic light, polished and richly detailed. Square composition with a quiet dark CENTRAL area, mountains framing the center rather than blocking it, bright atmospheric ice details around edges; plenty of legible space for a centered gold logo occupying approximately one third of image width. No people, no watermarks, no UI, no border, no written symbols.

Aspect ratio about 3:1, landscape sweeping Freljord snow mountain range, distant glacier-lit valley, subtle ancient weathered stone architecture, elegant cinematic painterly concept art consistent with League of Legends environment illustrations. Quiet deep navy CENTRAL area for gold logo, icy blue framing silhouettes and finely lit mountains at both sides, warm subtle gold light on a few edges. No characters, no additional objects of focus, no letters, no runic text, no watermark or border. Finished high quality environment art.
